offers_products.reason: Offers physician clinical services in hospitals; no products named among its main offerings.

offers_services.reason: Neonatology, maternal-fetal medicine, OB hospitalist and pediatric specialty care delivered by its clinicians.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Patients (women, babies, children) receive the care, though hospitals contract the services.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Partners with nearly 400 hospitals and health systems that contract for its clinical services; payors also pay.

recurring_revenue.reason: Ongoing hospital partnerships and continuing patient care, billed to payors and hospitals repeatedly.

cyclical_demand.reason: Neonatal, high-risk obstetric and pediatric critical care are medical needs that can't be postponed.

big_ticket.reason: Clinical care is billed per patient encounter or ongoing coverage, not as a large infrequent purchase.

people_delivered.reason: Value is physicians' and advanced practitioners' time and skill; care stops if clinicians leave.

large_customers.reason: Patients and payors plus hospitals; mixed with households, so not mainly large enterprises or government.

asset_heavy.reason: Clinicians work in partner hospitals' facilities; growth needs staff rather than plants, fleets or properties.

notes: Buyer mix is ambiguous: hospitals contract the services, while patients and payors receive and pay for care.
